title: Retrofit: Continual Learning with Controlled Forgetting for Binary Security Detection and Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2511.11439v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Binary security has increasingly relied on deep learning to reason about malware behavior and program semantics. However, the performance often degrades as threat landscapes evolve and code representations shift. While continual learning (CL) offers a natural solution through sequential updates, most existing approaches rely on data replay or unconstrained updates, limiting their applicability and effectiveness in data-sensitive security environments. We propose RETROFIT, which regulates knowledge retention and adaptation with controlled forgetting at each update, without requiring historical data. Our key idea is to consolidate previously trained and newly fine-tuned models, serving as teachers of legacy and emergent knowledge, through retrospective-free parameter merging. translated_title: 改造：具有受控遗忘的持续学习用于二进制安全检测与分析
translated_abstract: 二进制安全领域日益依赖深度学习来推理恶意软件行为和程序语义。然而，随着威胁格局的演变和代码表示的转变，性能往往会下降。虽然持续学习（CL）通过顺序更新提供了一种自然的解决方案，但大多数现有方法依赖数据重放或无约束更新，限制了它们在数据敏感的安全环境中的适用性和有效性。我们提出了RETROFIT，它通过每次更新时受控的遗忘来调节知识保留和适应，无需历史数据。我们的关键思想是整合先前训练和新微调的模型，作为旧知识和新知识的教师，通过无回顾的参数合并实现。遗忘控制通过以下方式实现：1）将参数变化限制在低秩和稀疏子空间中，以实现近似正交性；2）采用置信度...
tldr: 本文提出RETROFIT方法，通过无回顾的参数合并和受控遗忘，在不依赖历史数据的情况下实现二进制安全分析的持续学习，有效平衡知识保留与适应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes RETROFIT, which enables continual learning for binary security analysis via retrospective-free parameter merging and controlled forgetting, balancing knowledge retention and adaptation without requiring historical data.
